svg.title: Google Cloud ML lifecycle for the Tchibo Meridian MMM
svg.desc: Sources flow into Cloud Storage and BigQuery, are validated and turned into features, trained weekly by a Vertex AI pipeline that fits Meridian, evaluated against the 15 % MAE / mean gate, registered, served as batch forecasts and an interactive scenario service, consumed in MMM Studio and Looker Studio, and monitored against actual sales to trigger retraining. Cloud Build deploys the pipeline itself.
svg.text: Google Cloud ML lifecycle · Tchibo daily sales forecast with Google Meridian
Weekly continuous training (MLOps level 1) with CI/CD for the pipeline (level 2) · region europe-west3 · target: MAE / mean ≤ 15 %
one service account per stage (least privilege) · Secret Manager · VPC Service Controls · CMEK · Dataplex lineage · Cloud Audit Logs · EU data residency
already running in the project today (MMM Studio on Cloud Run: Cloud Storage, Artifact Registry, Cloud Build, Cloud Run service + jobs)
quality gate: a model is promoted only if it meets the brief's 15 % target
